title: Reading the PE headers

milestone.title: Ground Rules, Tools and the PE Format

hints: Write one helper that reads an `n`-byte little-endian number at an offset, and the parsing becomes a list of reads at the offsets in the lesson's tables. The file header is at `e_lfanew + 4`, the optional header 20 bytes after that, and the section table `SizeOfOptionalHeader` bytes after that.
Check sizes before every read: `e_lfanew` can point anywhere, and a damaged or hostile file must never make your parser read past the end.
